title: 第4章 砍运

content_zh:
银白的月光之下，坟头前立着一块青色大石碑，因为年头久远的缘故，上面长满了青色石苔，不过还隐隐看出上面的字迹，写着家父宋海之墓，以及亡母孙氏。
蒋玄英围着坟头转了一圈，细细打量了一阵，随即停下来，他首先将八卦盘放置坟尖之上，随即拿出那八张符纸围着坟头走动，每走一步便扔出一张，说也奇怪，他扔出黄符之时手指便会随之捻动一下，只听“啪”的一声，随着他这一捻动黄符瞬间燃烧起来，转眼间便化为灰烬。
我师父从小到大哪见过这种奇异之事，顿时眼睛瞪得直溜溜，嘴巴张大，都快要快要塞下一枚鸡蛋了。
他好奇之下，拉了拉马真人的衣角，指着蒋玄英问道:“老爷爷，我师傅他怎么手一动那黄纸就自己冒起火来呀？都不用火点吗？”
“哦？竟有此事？”
马真人双眼看不见，但听我师父说完，心里一惊，暗道：“我还是小瞧玄英了，没想到他的道行已经如此之深了，竟然能凭借体内的阳火来点燃符咒，看来他出去跑江湖的这几年肯定遇到过天大的造化。”
马真人模了模我师父的脑袋，解释道：“正心，你师傅之所以能无火起符，是因为道法高深的缘故，你以后要好好跟着他学道，将来有一天，说不定你也可以跟他一样，退一步讲，就算你学到他十分之一的本事，这辈子也吃喝不愁了。”
我师父乖巧的点了点头，看着施法之中的蒋玄英，眼中异彩涟涟，一颗学道的种子，不知不觉，已经深深的扎根在心里。
坟地那里，蒋玄英已经把手里的八张符咒燃烧殆尽，随即他又一掌宽，刀刃之处还有几个缺口。
别看这刀其貌不扬，但乍一拿出，方圆十丈之内立刻刮起阵阵阴风。
后来听我师傅说，他隔着大老远也能感觉到一股透彻心底的寒意，并且还能隐约听见一阵阵鬼哭狼嚎之声自刀上传来。
听他讲我才知道，蒋玄英拿出的是一把万人斩，也就是古代刽子手用过的屠刀，死在这刀下的冤魂不下万人，沾有死者的怨气以及死气，是一把凶名赫赫的煞刀。
蒋玄英右手握住煞刀威风凛凛的站在坟门前方，左手探进肩膀的布袋子拿出一张符咒，不过这张不是黄色的，而是一张蓝色的，他顺手一甩之下，蓝色符咒向坟头上方缓缓飘去。
紧接着他双脚踩地，每一脚落下之后，地上都会被踏出一个深深的脚印，同时他左手掐决，身子扭动，踏着一种极为古怪的步伐，嘴里念道：
“巽风忙忙雷起兴，冯夷鼓舞怒不停，关伯撼动天地昏，飞砂走石穿山林，震响叆叇哮吼声，翻山入水怒涛惊，风起。急急如律令。”
随着话音一落，他猛地伸出手指，向空中的蓝色符纸一点。
“噗哧”的一声。
符咒无风自燃起来，一阵阴风诡异的凭空出现，形成肉.眼可见的漩涡状向坟头猛刮而去。
一时间，宋家坟地之内，是阴风阵阵，沙石飞扬，风云色变，马真人面色变了又变，紧忙拉着我师傅的手后退了几步，而蒋玄英则是握住煞刀，神色淡然，稳稳的站在坟门前方屹立不动。
当那旋窝阴风刮过之后，随之一阵阵锣鼓喧天的奏乐声音响起，只见坟头白烟滚滚，一队拿着唢呐喇叭乐器的人自坟头升起，后面跟着八个轿夫，抬着一顶枣红大轿，紫色的珠帘从轿顶一泻流下，耀眼的红色纹路布满整个轿身，冷眼一看去，奢华至极。

坐在轿中的是一个身穿古代官服，面色白净但稍显威严的大官，胸前的衣服上刺着一只仙鹤，不过他一见到站在坟前杀气腾腾的蒋玄英，顿时吓的面色如土，哪还有之前的威严之色啊，嘴里不停的催着八个轿夫抬着轿子赶紧走，如同老鼠见了猫一般。
就在这时，坟头上的八卦盘突然通体一震，发出一道黄蒙蒙的亮光，把整个坟地方圆数十丈的土地全部笼罩进去，八个轿夫见此面色慌乱不已，急忙的抬起轿子，夺路而逃。

content_en:
Under the silvery moonlight, there is a large green stone tablet standing in front of the tomb. Due to the age, it is covered with green stone moss, but the writing on it can still be faintly seen, which reads the tomb of my father Song Hai and my late mother Sun.
Jiang Xuanying circled around the grave, looked at it carefully for a while, and then stopped. He first placed the Bagua plate on the tip of the grave, then took out the eight talisman papers and walked around the grave, throwing one out every step. Strangely enough, when he threw out the yellow talisman, his fingers would twist, and there was only a "pop" sound. As he twisted the yellow talisman, it burned instantly and turned into ashes in the blink of an eye.
My master had never seen such a strange thing since he was a child. His eyes suddenly widened and his mouth opened wide, as if he was about to put an egg in his mouth.
Out of curiosity, he pulled the corner of Zhenren Ma's clothes, pointed at Jiang Xuanying and asked: "Grandpa, my master, how come the yellow paper bursts into flames when he moves his hand? Don't you even need to use fire?"
"Oh? Is this happening?"
Ma Zhenren could not see with his eyes, but when he heard what my master said, he was shocked and said to himself: "I still underestimated Xuanying. I didn't expect that his Taoism has reached such a depth that he can actually use the Yang Fire in his body to ignite the spell. It seems that he must have encountered great fortune in the past few years when he went out to travel around the world."
Ma Zhenren modeled my master's head and explained: "Zhengxin, the reason why your master can create a talisman without fire is because of the profound Taoism. You should learn from him carefully in the future. One day, maybe you can be like him. To say the least, even if you learn one-tenth of his skills, you will have no worries about food and drink in this life."
My master nodded obediently and looked at Jiang Xuanying who was casting the spell. His eyes were filled with sparkles, and a seed of Taoism had unknowingly taken root in his heart.
At the cemetery, Jiang Xuanying had burned all the eight talismans in his hand, and then he took another palm wide, and there were still a few gaps on the blade.
Although this knife looks unattractive, as soon as it is taken out, gusts of dark wind immediately blow within a radius of ten feet.
Later, my master said that he could feel a chill in his heart even from a long distance away, and he could also vaguely hear the sounds of ghosts crying and howling coming from the sword.
Only after listening to his story did I realize that what Jiang Xuanying took out was a butcher knife used by executioners in ancient times. No less than ten thousand souls died under this knife. It was stained with the resentment and death of the deceased. It was a murderous knife with a great reputation.
Jiang Xuanying stood majestically in front of the tomb door with the sword in her right hand. She reached into the cloth bag on her shoulder with her left hand and took out a charm. However, this one was not yellow, but a blue one. He flicked it and the blue charm slowly floated to the top of the tomb.
Then he stepped on the ground with both feet. After each foot landed, there would be a deep footprint on the ground. At the same time, he pinched with his left hand, twisted his body, walked in an extremely weird pace, and said in his mouth:
"Xunfeng is busy thundering, Feng Yizhu is furious, Guan Bo shakes the sky and the earth, flies sand and rocks through the mountains and forests, roars loudly, rolls over the mountains and into the water, roars the waves, and the wind rises. It is as urgent as the law."
As soon as he finished speaking, he suddenly stretched out his finger and pointed at the blue talisman in the air.
There was a "poof" sound.
The spell spontaneously ignited without wind, and a gust of wind appeared strangely out of thin air, forming a whirlpool visible to the naked eye and blowing towards the tomb.
For a moment, in the Song family cemetery, there were gusts of wind, sand and stones flying, and the weather changed. Master Ma's expression changed again and again, and he hurriedly took my master's hand and stepped back a few steps, while Jiang Xuanying held the evil sword and stood steadily in front of the tomb door with an indifferent expression.
When the gloomy wind blew over, bursts of loud gongs and drums sounded, and white smoke billowed from the tomb. A group of people holding suona and trumpet instruments rose from the tomb, followed by eight sedan bearers, carrying a large maroon sedan, with purple bead curtains rising from the tomb.The top of the sedan flows down, and dazzling red lines cover the entire sedan body. At a cold glance, it looks extremely luxurious.
Sitting in the sedan was a fair-faced but slightly majestic official wearing ancient official uniforms. There was a crane tattooed on his chest. However, when he saw the murderous Jiang Xuanying standing in front of the grave, his face turned pale with fear. He was not as majestic as before. He kept urging the eight sedan bearers to carry the sedan away, just like a mouse seeing a cat.
At this moment, the Bagua plate on the tomb suddenly shook and emitted a yellow light, covering dozens of feet of land around the entire tomb. Seeing this, the eight sedan bearers looked panicked and hurriedly lifted up the sedan and fled.
